problem.title: Running a SOC is expensive before it earns anything.
problem.body: Every managed security provider pays the same fixed costs: enterprise tool licences with minimum commitments, analysts who are hard to hire and harder to keep, round-the-clock shift coverage, training and certification, and the infrastructure underneath it all. Those costs arrive long before the contracts that pay for them.
facts: Licence minimums you pay for whether you use them or not
Night and weekend shifts that need full teams, not individuals
Senior talent that competitors keep poaching
Tooling that has to be integrated, tuned and maintained

seo.title: Services — licensing, talent, white-label SOC | System Formation
seo.description: Licensing as a service, security talent on demand, white-label SOC, shared platforms, surge capacity and compliance delivery kits — plus managed security for organisations.

hero.sub: Two ways to work with us: as the engine behind your own security practice, or as the provider running security for your organisation.

providers.title: For service providers
providers.intro: The fixed costs of a security practice, carried once and shared.

items.name: Licensing as a service
items.text: Access enterprise-grade SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, vulnerability management, email security and DLP through pooled, multi-tenant licensing. You draw on the capacity your contracts need, without signing individual minimum commitments. Entitlements move with your book of business rather than your renewal dates.

items.name: Security talent on demand
items.text: Certified L1–L3 SOC analysts, threat hunters, incident responders, GRC consultants and penetration testers, allocated to your projects when you need them. They work to your playbooks and report under your brand. You get the seniority a client expects without carrying it between engagements.

items.name: White-label SOC
items.text: Monitoring, detection and response around the clock, delivered under your brand. Alerts are triaged, escalated and closed against the SLA you have promised your client. You stay the single point of contact; we stay invisible.

items.name: Shared platforms and tooling
items.text: Integrated SIEM and SOAR, response playbooks, ticketing and client reporting portals, already tuned and maintained. Onboarding a new client means provisioning a tenant, not building a stack. Platform upkeep, tuning and version currency are ours to carry.

items.name: Surge and overflow capacity
items.text: Extra hands for large tenders, audit seasons, penetration testing windows and live incidents, without permanent hires. Capacity is agreed in advance and released when the peak passes. It lets you bid for work that your standing team could not absorb.

items.name: Compliance delivery kits
items.text: Assessment toolkits, Arabic and English policy templates and evidence packs for NCA, SAMA and PDPL engagements. Your consultants start from a structured baseline instead of a blank document. Every artefact is written to be handed to an auditor.

organisations.title: For organisations
organisations.intro: Security operations and compliance run for you, with accountability in writing.

items.name: Managed security services
items.text: A 24/7 security operations centre, managed detection and response, SIEM and log management, and managed firewall, email and endpoint security, backed by threat intelligence. We watch the environment, investigate what matters and act inside agreed response times. You get one team accountable for the whole chain.

items.name: Regulatory compliance
items.text: Gap assessments, roadmaps and implementation support for NCA, SAMA, PDPL and CST requirements. We translate control text into work your teams can actually schedule. Evidence is collected as you go, so audit season is a review rather than a scramble.

items.name: Assessments and testing
items.text: Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, maturity and risk assessments, and audit readiness reviews. Findings come with exploitability, business impact and a fix that fits your environment. Retesting confirms the gap actually closed.

items.name: Virtual CISO
items.text: Security leadership on a defined commitment: strategy, risk decisions, board and management reporting, and programme governance. You get an experienced security executive without a full-time hire. The role scales up around audits, incidents and funding cycles.

cta.title: Not sure which side you sit on?
cta.body: Many partners start as a client and add white-label delivery later. A short call is enough to work out the right shape.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | System Formation
seo.description: How System Formation Co. Ltd collects, uses and protects personal data submitted through this website, aligned to the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.

privacy.draftNotice: Draft for legal review. This policy has been prepared as a starting point and must be reviewed by qualified counsel before launch.

p: System Formation Co. Ltd ("System Formation", "we") is a company registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, commercial registration [CR NUMBER], with its registered address at [CITY / ADDRESS]. We are the controller of the personal data described in this policy.
When you submit the contact form we collect the name, company, email address, phone number, the audience and interest you select, and the content of your message.

Our hosting provider processes technical information needed to deliver the site securely, including IP address and request metadata. We do not use advertising or behavioural tracking cookies, and we do not embed third-party trackers.

We use contact form submissions for one purpose: to respond to your enquiry and, where you ask us to, to prepare a commercial proposal. We rely on your consent, given by submitting the form, and on our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for marketing unrelated to your enquiry.

sections.h: A security check on the form
p: The contact form is protected by a bot-detection service to stop automated abuse. It receives technical signals about the request. It does not receive the content of your message.

Enquiries are retained for [RETENTION PERIOD] from the last contact, after which they are deleted or anonymised. Where an enquiry becomes a contract, the related records are retained under the retention period required by Saudi commercial and tax law.

Personal data is available to System Formation staff who need it to answer you, and to the service providers that operate our website infrastructure and email under contract. We do not disclose it to anyone else except where the law requires it.
Where personal data is transferred outside the Kingdom, we apply the conditions set out in the Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing regulations.

Under the Personal Data Protection Law you may ask to access your personal data, correct it, request its destruction, withdraw consent, and be informed of how it is used. Write to info@systemformation.com and we will respond within the period the law allows.
If you believe we have not handled your data correctly, you may complain to the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA).
We will update this page when our practices change, and will change the date above when we do.
